verdict.rationale: PostHog advertises built-in AI capabilities (PostHog AI writing Hog functions, MCP-driven agents that can ship flags/query data/fix errors, and an agent that turns product signals into reports and PRs steerable from Slack/web/desktop) suggesting a genuine in-product assistant. However, direct hands-on community feedback reports the LLM/cohort assistant failing basic tasks and causing severe performance issues, contradicting the polish implied by the docs.
